d: High school teacher Lauren is accused of an affair by a student, putting her job and life in jeopardy.

This is the true story of the kidnapping of Amber Hagerman and how her family came together to help other abducted children as a result of her tragedy  which resulted in a new system to help find missing children - The Amber Alert.
A troubled youth vandalizes a church and winds up in a close association with the woodcarver whose work he destroyed.
A British exchange student upends her host family's life when she tries to take the place of their daughter.
